parts.name: Blade Handle Set
parts.Basic_description: This part includes one blade and its attached handle, made of stainless steel for the blade and plastic for the handle.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as one half of the cutting mechanism and provides a grip for the user to apply force.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around the central screw pivot to open and close during cutting.

parts.name: Blade Handle Set
parts.Basic_description: This is the second blade and handle assembly, similar to the first, forming the other half of the scissors.
parts.Functional_description: It works in conjunction with the first blade to perform the cutting action.
parts.Movement_description: It pivots around the screw joint, moving opposite to the first blade handle set.

parts.name: Screw
parts.Basic_description: A small steel screw that connects the two blade handle sets at the pivot point.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the two blades together and allows them to rotate smoothly around the pivot.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary while allowing rotational movement of the blades around it.

parts.name: Securing Clip (Other)
parts.Basic_description: A small metallic clip used to secure the screw or maintain tension between the blades.
parts.Functional_description: It ensures the screw remains tight and the blades maintain proper alignment.
parts.Movement_description: It does not move during normal operation but may flex slightly under tension.

parts.name: Securing Clip (Other)
parts.Basic_description: Another securing clip component, similar to the previous one, used for additional stability.
parts.Functional_description: It provides extra fastening support to the pivot assembly.
parts.Movement_description: It remains fixed and does not move during scissor operation.
